# PCB Vision AI — Project Summary for LLMs & AI Systems

> PCB Vision AI is an open-source, client-side automated optical inspection (AOI) web application for bare Printed Circuit Board (PCB) defect detection and classification.

## Core Capabilities
- **Deep Learning Inference:** Runs YOLOv8n compiled to ONNX Opset 18 directly inside client browser memory via ONNX Runtime Web (WebAssembly SIMD multi-threaded). Zero cloud server transmission; 100% data privacy.
- **Classical Digital Image Processing (DIP):** Features an interactive difference-based inspection laboratory employing Gaussian filtering, golden-reference subtraction, Otsu/Fixed thresholding, morphological opening/closing, and Connected-Component Analysis (CCA).
- **Supported Defect Taxonomy (6 Classes):**
  1. Open Circuit (Class 0, Red)
  2. Short Circuit (Class 1, Orange)
  3. Mouse Bite (Class 2, Yellow)
  4. Spur (Class 3, Purple)
  5. Spurious Copper (Class 4, Cyan)
  6. Pin Hole (Class 5, Green)
- **Empirical Held-Out DeepPCB Benchmarks:**
  - Precision: 92.46%
  - Recall: 94.48%
  - mAP@50: 95.64%
  - mAP@50-95: 76.18%
  - PyTorch vs. ONNX Runtime parity: 100% bounding box parity (mean IoU 0.999999)

## Important Domain Boundaries & Research Disclaimers
- The AI model was trained on the **DeepPCB** benchmark dataset (1,500 bare-board pairs, 10,013 annotations).
- Designed specifically for bare (unpopulated) PCB substrates. It is NOT trained for populated/assembled PCB boards with soldered ICs, resistors, or surface-mount devices (SMD).
- Optical detection of surface copper trace anomalies does not constitute electrical continuity certification. It does not replace in-circuit bed-of-nails or flying-probe testing.

## Links & Repository
